description: MarU is the maritime emission model of the Norwegian Coastal Administration, which uses AIS ship tracking data to estimate the energy demand, greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution of shipping in Norwegian waters. The page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the model splits emissions by ship type, ship size and area, down to municipalities and counties, and by domestic, international or transit traffic, and that it succeeds the estimates offered through the Havbase service since 2012. Results are published in a Power BI report updated every month with data from 2016 to the present, and the page offers files for download and a glossary. Coverage is Norwegian waters. Access is free; the reuse licence was not stated in the text read. Caveats: only direct tank-to-wake emissions are estimated, the model is still under development, and a known error understates fuel saved by shore power until the next update. It supports port and shipping planning studies, such as sizing shore power demand in a port municipality from the energy use of calling ships. Related record: Kystdatahuset holds the AIS traffic data behind it.
